answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow bond: each new identity locks 75 credits in the oasis vault and registers a fourteen-step sonnet, replayed by auditors; a rented-fingerprint ring burns with its twins. Honest trails spread thin across the tundra, sharing at most eight steps. Enrollment is 40 plus 6 per earlier identity: the 1,000th pays 6,034; a thousand fakes 3,037,000 plus 75,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 40 once.
